method: strokes-v1 (measures.json, summary.json). Twelve works chosen from the measures to show the range of the build: the sparsest early face, the darkest, the most translucent, the beams, a summer mask, the densest drawing, the one repeated title, a collection piece, a Rawblocks portrait, the last landscape and a late mask. Each is shown at five points in its recorded stroke order (after 10, 25, 50, 75 and 100 percent of the drawn strokes, the board's background pass kept in every frame), drawn in the browser from the native SVG by the same path order the replay uses. The readings were written after looking at the five frames of each work at full size; every number is from measures.json.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #5
works.why: The sparsest face: 28 strokes on the bare white canvas, with no background pass.
works.reading: The exception that shows the rule. With no background pass, the hand lays its own ground: three wide strokes of crimson and black scribble fill the square before anything else, the one work here that opens with mass. The face then arrives as line, white and cyan at a quarter, a yellow-green contour at a half, and the eyes and mouth in blue in the last quarter. Twenty-eight strokes in all.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #41
works.why: The most worked of the dark faces: 1,019 strokes on a dark ground, December 2021.
works.reading: A face found, not drawn. The first tenth is patches of purple, orange and blue laid on the dark ground with no head in them; by a quarter they are loops; the eyes and the white of the teeth only appear at the half, and the face is legible at three quarters. The last quarter is green and white highlights over paint already two deep, which is why 96% of every stroke here lands on earlier paint.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #62
works.why: The winter portraits: 342 of its 417 strokes are translucent, the highest share of any face.
works.reading: Painted the way a portrait is painted. The first tenth blocks the head in grey planes on black; the next quarter glazes ochre and green over them; by the half the face is modelled with no eyes in it. The eyes are drawn green at three quarters, and the last quarter darkens them under a translucent glaze and deepens the shadow on the right, so the finished face is dimmer and more inward than the one at three quarters.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #85
works.why: A beam head from May 11, 2022, the week the market fell: 698 strokes, 305 of them translucent.
works.reading: The beam comes last. The headdress and the ochre body are blocked first, the colors of the brick crown by a quarter, the dark eyes at the half, the outlines at three quarters. Then the yellow beams, translucent, are laid over the whole finished figure in the final quarter, which is why the complete drawing is paler and warmer than any frame before it. The light is the last decision, drawn the week the market fell.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #150
works.why: A mask of the summer, June 21, 2022, at the series median: 153 strokes, almost all opaque.
works.reading: A mask built from the ground out. The first tenth is a green blob and red and grey stripes with no mask in them; the mask's outline is drawn over them by a quarter; black contours and the teeth come at the half; blue and more pattern at three quarters; and the blue lattice at the lower right and the black frame close it. Almost nothing is translucent: each new stroke covers rather than tints.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #219
works.why: The densest drawing in the collection: 1,757 strokes, August 12, 2022, the day after the burn was announced.
works.reading: Dabs, then light, then a glaze. The first tenth is the tree in black contour with pink and yellow dabs on grey; by a quarter the dabs have multiplied and the red ground has arrived at the bottom. The yellow beams of light are laid at the half, over the tree and down through the fence; then three quarters adds white and pink dabs over the light. The last quarter is a dark yellow glaze over everything, which dims the tree the hand had just brightened. 1,757 strokes, 551 of them translucent, drawn the day after the burn was announced.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #249
works.why: The one repeated title: two drawings called #249 on August 25, 2022, 304 and 313 strokes, the same 132 translucent strokes in each.
works.reading: Two drawings with one build. The frames match at every point: the pink stripes of the ground, the black cat drawn as a silhouette by a quarter, its ringed eyes and the red mark at the half, the yellow and blue pattern after. The record holds two drawings under this title, created the same day, the second with nine more strokes than the first; the frames of both are shown so the match can be seen. The repeated title in the rooms is this pair.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #0000
works.why: The collection piece of New Nifty on the Block, October 15, 2022: 447 strokes, the lowest overpainting of any dense work here.
works.reading: The face first, the surround last. In the first tenth the skull is already drawn in white and blue line with the yellow X over its eye; red loops and yellow drips come by a quarter; the dotted purple halo at the half; cyan dots and lines at three quarters; and the orange rays, the sun at the upper right and the yellow stripes in the final quarter. The drawing grows outward from the head, which is why so little of it lands on earlier paint: 74%, the lowest of any dense work here.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #18
works.why: A Rawblocks portrait from November 7, 2022: 707 strokes, 482 of them translucent, paint with line on top.
works.reading: Paint first, line in the middle, glaze last. The head is blocked in translucent pink and olive patches for the first quarter, with the dark hair arriving late in it; the hat, the glasses and the mouth are drawn in line at the half; the red hair, the lattice on the hat and the red ground come at three quarters. The last quarter is pink and cyan glazes over the face and the ground, so the finished portrait is softer than the one at three quarters.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #65
works.why: The last Rawblocks, the landscape that closes the series on March 15, 2023: 1,060 strokes, 909 translucent.
works.reading: A landscape in washes. Purple, pink and blue cover the square in the first tenth, sky above and water below; the skyline is drawn dark by a quarter, with the path lines; the buildings take color and the water pink at the half; the green foliage at three quarters. The final quarter lays a pale glaze over the whole scene and puts the trees and the red trunk in front of it, the last Rawblocks closing with a veil over the city.

works.title: nnxyz #64
works.why: A late mask, December 4, 2024, after a year away: 431 strokes, dense rather than broad.
works.reading: The head is there in the first tenth. Forty-four strokes draw the outline, the teeth and the eyes, and the remaining 387 fill, color and surround it: the yellow contour and the red beam by a quarter, the grey hair at the half, the purple lettering at three quarters, the black ground, the blue scribble and the signature last. After a year away the hand draws the structure at once and spends the rest of the drawing on its surface: dense, as the measures say, not broad.
